about: Every Hugging Face file NeuroVLM reads, pinned to a commit with its sha256. scripts/data/fetch_hf.py downloads and verifies them. local_name: name inside the package data dir (null = read from the HF cache only); hf_cache: also read through the HF cache by library loaders / from_pretrained; groups: pipeline (training + validation), figures (main + review figures), regenerate (data stages 01-07), extra; ref: the cache ref fetch_hf points at revision. pins: revision only, not downloaded. Pinned 2026-10-09. not_on_hub: inputs that are not on the Hub, pinned by sha256 only (passed to the script that reads them).
